facts.business: Oswal Pumps Limited manufactures and supplies solar pumping systems for agricultural, domestic, and industrial applications, and is expanding into rooftop solar EPC projects.

capacity_or_capex.item: Setting up new manufacturing units at Karnal, Haryana (via Oswal Solar Energy Private Limited)

key_risks: Dependence on government schemes (PM-KUSUM, PM Surya Ghar) for solar pump and rooftop solar demand
Execution risk in new manufacturing units at Karnal, Haryana
Concentration in agricultural solar pump replacement market (8 million diesel pumps)
Policy and incentive structure changes in renewable energy sector
facts.related_party_note: Investments in wholly-owned subsidiaries Oswal Solar Energy Private Limited (equity for manufacturing setup and loan repayment) and Walso Solar Solution Private Limited (became subsidiary from June 08, 2026); transactions with Doon Infrapower for rooftop solar projects in Rajasthan.
